Proposition
[Sobolev interpolation hierarchy]

Source: petersen:page-0307 ↗ thm:pet-ch7-poincare-sobolev 1. ch7:7.1.17Suppose every smooth function on $(M,g)$ satisfies $\| u-u_M\| _{s-1}\le S\| du\| _1$ for some fixed $s>1$. Then for $1\le p<s$, \[ \| u\| _{\frac{sp}{s-p}}\le \frac{p(s-1)}{s-p}S\| du\| _p+\| u\| _p. \]
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch7-sobolev-hierarchy \sketch For $p=1$, compare $u$ with its mean and use $|u_M|\le \| u\| _1$. For $p>1$, apply the assumed estimate to $|u|^q$, use Hölder on $q|u|^{q-1}|du|$, and choose $q=p(s-1)/(s-p)$. Dividing by the resulting norm gives the claimed coefficient.

□
